rootinstruction_source: Parent/root message: normalize CPU binary64 before Float32; maxAbs first; canonical values/digest/ranks unchanged; zero extent no spreading.

cases.danger: Float32 before CPU normalization collapses values; inverse tiny scale cannot go in instanceMatrix
required: distinct finite displayed extents when CPU normalization can represent them

cases.danger: Direct max-min overflows despite every input coordinate being finite
Zero extent must not trigger division, jitter or fabricated spread
required: all IDs remain available to DOM inspection

cases.danger: After maxAbs normalization extent may be subnormal; forming reciprocal overflows
required: divide each CPU delta by extent before displaySpan multiplication
do not store extreme normalization in Float32 instanceMatrix
finite bounded display positions or honest collapse only if CPU representational extent is zero
